Game Overview

At its heart, Click Kitty Idle is a clicker game about compete in an adorable cat-clicking race where speed and strategy rule. Tap to feed your kitty, level up, and outscore opponents in this fast-paced, addictive idle game. Think quick, click smart, and showcase your lightning-fast reflexes.
